steps.text: Shuffle the Discovery tiles facedown; 2 faceup on the Exploration space
Warehouse: {n} each of Crystals, Batteries, Water, Plants and Oxygen
Set the Shelter Tech tiles aside; split the rest into two sets by back, shuffle one set faceup onto the Tech Grid
Shuffle the 8 remaining Tech tiles into two facedown stacks by the Tech Grid
2 players: use only 1 set of Tech tiles; remove the second set
Blueprints: shuffle Level 1 and Level 3 separately, Level 1 on top; 6 faceup in a display
Scientist display: Geologist, R&D Engineer, Hydrologist, Biochemist, Geochemist, Systems Engineer left to right, each with its marker
Earth Contract cards facedown on the Scientist display
Starting Mine (S back) in the center; the other starting Buildings at random on the marked hexes, notch toward the bottom
Building display: Buildings in shuffled stacks by type, building side down
Research tiles by type on their map hexes
Missions: 2 Short + 1 Long (short game) or 1 Short + 2 Long (long game), each with its marker and a tracker cube on the space for your player count
steps.note: First game: First Colonists variant, p.24

steps.text: Remaining Missions marker on 3; Crystals and Resources as a supply
Colony level marker on the left of the second row; LSS Track markers on the bottom row; 4 random LSS Reward tiles faceup
Player board; OP marker on 0; 1 of each of the 5 Resources in Storage; 1 Crystal in the Depot
Shelter Tech tile on the middle space of the 2nd Laboratory column; 5 Ships on the top 5 Depot spaces
5 Shelters: 4 on your board, 1 on your starting hex for the player count, with 1 of your 4 Bots on it
8 Advanced Building markers and a Rover beside your board; 3 Colonists in the Living Quarters, 9 beside the board
5 Progress cubes, one below each Resource; deal 3 secret Private Goal cards each
Whoever has seen The Martian most is first; clockwise each puts their Player marker on a Turn Order space and may take its benefit
The player on the highest Turn Order space places the Shuttle on a red Travel space, Colony or Orbit side
